objective: Make independently checked complete root sets and root-free closed boxes portable between native processes and interactive NDJSON sessions.

implemented.statement_binding: Receiver supplies its own typed original equations, ordered symbol identities, exact requested domain and context. These are compared before bounded local witness construction.
implemented.acceptance: Canonical byte comparison and a fresh independent complete-cover check are mandatory. Serialized counts, accepted flags, claimed root enclosures and contraction bounds cannot grant acceptance.
implemented.empty_results: A complete original-source exclusion cover is replayed to establish zero roots; omitting roots cannot establish a root-free box.
implemented.trust_boundary: Never deserialize untrusted Expr or accepted receipts. Borrow source/axis/domain payloads, bound root and partition sequences before excess entries, and use the existing bounded exact-rational root-witness decoder.
implemented.resource_accounting: Charge bounded witness decoding separately per root; preserve cumulative protected verifier compute, shared memory/allocation limits and cancellation. Both root codecs reserve bounded escaped-key parser scratch growth.
implemented.publication: Successful Session replay reuses existing atomic complete-isolation publication: all child IDs, collisions, capacities and complete response admission precede either parent or child insertion.
